question: For each customer and each month of 2020, first calculate the month-end balance by adding all deposit amounts and subtracting all withdrawal amounts that occurred during that specific month. Then determine which month in 2020 has the highest count of customers with a positive month-end balance and which month has the lowest count. For each of these two months, compute the average month-end balance across all customers and provide the difference between these two averages
sql:
-- Now let me compute the final answer: difference between highest avg (Jan) and lowest avg (Apr)
WITH monthly_customer_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', txn_date::DATE) AS month_start,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
            WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS month_end_balance
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_date >= '2020-01-01' AND txn_date <= '2020-12-31'
    GROUP BY customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', txn_date::DATE)
),
monthly_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        month_start,
        SUM(CASE WHEN month_end_balance > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_count
    FROM monthly_customer_balance
    GROUP BY month_start
),
ranked_months AS (
    SELECT 
        month_start,
        positive_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_count DESC) AS highest_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_count ASC) AS lowest_rank
    FROM monthly_counts
),
avg_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        mcb.month_start,
        AVG(mcb.month_end_balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM monthly_customer_balance mcb
    JOIN ranked_months rm ON mcb.month_start = rm.month_start
    WHERE rm.highest_rank = 1 OR rm.lowest_rank = 1
    GROUP BY mcb.month_start
)
SELECT 
    MAX(CASE WHEN rm.highest_rank = 1 THEN ab.avg_balance END) AS highest_avg_balance,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rm.lowest_rank = 1 THEN ab.avg_balance END) AS lowest_avg_balance,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rm.highest_rank = 1 THEN ab.avg_balance END) - MAX(CASE WHEN rm.lowest_rank = 1 THEN ab.avg_balance END) AS difference
FROM avg_balances ab
JOIN ranked_months rm ON ab.month_start = rm.month_start

WITH monthly_customer_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', txn_date::DATE) AS month_start,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
            WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS month_end_balance
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_date >= '2020-01-01' AND txn_date <= '2020-12-31'
    GROUP BY customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', txn_date::DATE)
),
monthly_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        month_start,
        SUM(CASE WHEN month_end_balance > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_count
    FROM monthly_customer_balance
    GROUP BY month_start
),
ranked_months AS (
    SELECT 
        month_start,
        positive_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_count DESC) AS highest_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_count ASC) AS lowest_rank
    FROM monthly_counts
),
avg_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        mcb.month_start,
        AVG(mcb.month_end_balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM monthly_customer_balance mcb
    JOIN ranked_months rm ON mcb.month_start = rm.month_start
    WHERE rm.highest_rank = 1 OR rm.lowest_rank = 1
    GROUP BY mcb.month_start
)
SELECT 
    MAX(CASE WHEN rm.highest_rank = 1 THEN ab.avg_balance END) AS highest_avg_balance,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rm.lowest_rank = 1 THEN ab.avg_balance END) AS lowest_avg_balance,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rm.highest_rank = 1 THEN ab.avg_balance END) - MAX(CASE WHEN rm.lowest_rank = 1 THEN ab.avg_balance END) AS difference
FROM avg_balances ab
JOIN ranked_months rm ON ab.month_start = rm.month_start
